author: OwensAdopted
body:
II have been thinking about what some of the moderators have been saying. They are right. It wouldn't get many players on. So this is what I was thinking. This could be an update for Nexus. Make this a beta update of Nexus. Put it up for a couple days and see what people think. If it's good, keep it. Bad, well, take her down!


This is a game based on my two personal favorite games. Nexus and Nebula. (Still thinking of a name! If you come up with one, please suggest it!) So here are the basics. 

#1. You play the same way you play Nexus, most kills when.

#2. Here is the twist! You have a monument, but closer and easier to get to then in Nebula. Like, a staircase behind a team's spawn. It has one emerald block, when you mine it, you get 10 points for your team. Or how ever many the Staff decides.  

#3. Breaking blocks IS allowed OUTSIDE of the monument. However, near the monument, that would be overpowered. Wouldn't you say? 

#4. They're will be kits. Just normal Nexus kits. Just adding a diamond pickaxe.

#5. People's items do NOT drop. However you do get a golden apple when you get a kill.

#6. This game would simply not have a time limit. It shall go on until a score limit is reached. I would suggest around 500. I like nice long games!

#7. Once you have mined to other teams Emerald block, it will "Respawn" in 25 seconds. All nice and fresh to me mined once again!

To just briefly go over how the game is played, if you didn't understand this. I'll explain quickly. When you kill someone from another team, you get one point for your team. There is an emerald block at the other team's spawn. If you mine this you get 10 points for your team. (or as I said, how ever many staff would decide.) First team to 500 total points wins the game!
 
Well, That is it for (unamed) basics. If any staff members are interested in adding the game to "Avicus". Then please contact me on skype. (on my profile) Thanks for reading! ALL feedback is respected!

replies.author: D00ZiE
replies.body:
I would say change the obsidian block to an emerald block and make it worth 10 points and respawn in 25 seconds.

Another thing about the gamemode is that it could become a little stale without kits. Since it is mostly just TDM with a pinch of DTM I don't think that it should have it's own "Gamemode". I think it would best fit into the Nexus rotations( Basically just adding a diamond pick to any chosen nexus kit).
